title: Did truncating PathVQA to 1,500 of 3,357 questions bias the reported number?
probe: genframe_head_ens8 (frozen incumbent, layer 21) -- trained on pathvqa_open_TRAIN, never on pathvqa_open, so all 3,357 are clean for it
VERDICT: the reported 1,500-question subset gives verifier-minus-greedy +0.0487; the full 3,357-question benchmark gives +0.0313 (-0.0174). The 1,857 restored questions are harder -- greedy 0.2908 against 0.3427 -- and the verifier's measured gain moves materially, so every PathVQA delta in the project must be restated on the full benchmark.
